description: We are a team interested in space and science. We want to create an interesting project about the machines left behind in space and the discoveries they made. We are looking for a fun way to share their stories and teach others about space exploration.
summary: Our project is a short animated educational video about human-made objects left in space and across the solar system. It focuses on three important examples: the Spirit rover, the Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector, and Voyager 1. Through animations and interesting facts, we aim to explain their history, purpose, and scientific importance. Our goal is to help students and young people understand how these objects contribute to space exploration and why they remain valuable even after many years. The video will make space science more accessible, engaging, and enjoyable for everyone.
details:
Our project, The Forgotten Explorers, is an animated educational video about three important pieces of space hardware: the Spirit Rover, the Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector, and Voyager 1.

The video works through animations, images, storytelling, and short explanations to present the history, purpose, and scientific importance of each object. It shows how these technologies contributed to space exploration and why they remain important even when they are no longer active.

The main benefit of our project is making scientific information easier to understand and more entertaining, especially for younger audiences. Our intended impact is to increase interest in space exploration and help people discover the importance of forgotten space technology.

To develop our project, we used Canva and digital animation tools, a computer, NASA websites for reliable research, and images and illustrations of the selected space objects. We did not require specialized hardware or programming languages.

Our project is creative because it combines science, animation, and storytelling to present real space missions in an engaging way. Instead of simply presenting facts, we use visual elements to make the information more interesting and accessible.

During development, our team considered the accuracy of the information, the clarity of the explanations, accessibility for younger audiences, available resources, production costs, and environmental sustainability. Since the project is entirely digital, it does not require printing or expensive physical materials.
